result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue where content is being cut off on the right side of the viewport, preventing full visibility of restaurant cards in the 'Fastest near you' section.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section (Trattoria Piccol) is horizontally truncated and partially cut off on the right side of the screen, making it impossible to see the complete card, delivery fee, or timing information
issues.suggestion: Adjust the carousel/grid layout to either show complete cards with proper padding, implement horizontal scrolling with visible overflow indicators, or reduce card size to fit more naturally within the viewport width
